## Description

<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:BEGIN -->
The public @opum-ai/quest@0.2.8 release-candidate has a verified product/packaging defect: from a fresh registry install, quest agents --update-instructions --json exits 0 but writes 'This project uses Quest CLI 0.2.7' into the managed AGENTS block. Root cause: the managed-instructions template carries a hand-synced version literal, and the committed platform binaries (built at ff08c02) predate the 8357259 instructions sync, so the packed 0.2.8 bundle ships a stale 0.2.7 template while its own VERSION constant says 0.2.8. Smallest durable fix: derive the template text and drift message from a single QUEST_VERSION constant (src/application/version.ts) consumed by the CLI so generated managed instructions always name the actual release version and cannot drift; add red-to-green regressions at the source and packed seams (packaged --update-instructions must write the package version and agents --check --require-installed must exit 0). Bump the full Quest package family coherently to 0.2.9, rebuild all six platform artifacts, run all relevant source, packaging, launcher, binding, and platform-manifest tests, build the seven-tarball 0.2.9 candidate with immutable provenance metadata, prove a clean isolated install (root/native/launcher 0.2.9 + managed instructions naming 0.2.9), and deliver via normal PR to dev with required CI green and owner-local Backlog/Lore settlement. Zero npm publishes, no tag moves, no promotion, no history rewrite, no primary-dirt cleanup, no opum-cli-e2e mutation.
<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:END -->

- [x] #5 Delivered via normal PR to dev with required CI green and owner-local Backlog/Lore settlement; zero npm publishes, no tag moves, no promotion, no history rewriting, no primary-dirt cleanup, no opum-cli-e2e mutation

## Implementation Plan

<!-- SECTION:PLAN:BEGIN -->
RED first at both seams (source: block must name QUEST_VERSION; packed: written instructions must name the package version), then the minimal derivation fix (src/application/version.ts consumed by main.ts and agent-instructions.ts), coherent 0.2.9 family bump, rebuild all six platform binaries via build:packages, full check + check:packages + test:packages, candidate pack with provenance, isolated install proof, PR to dev, merge, Backlog/Lore settlement, lease return.
<!-- SECTION:PLAN:END -->

## Implementation Notes

<!-- SECTION:NOTES:BEGIN -->
2026-08-28 settlement evidence (order 7f659bf7ca9a47968ce9c7647e741b2f): RED captured at both seams (source: template literal 0.2.8 vs QUEST_VERSION 0.2.9; packed: stale-artifact guard 'Packed launcher wrote managed instructions with a stale release version' against the shipped-defect class), then GREEN after derivation + rebuild. Full check suite green 297/297 incl. check:packages and test:packages with the exact agents --update-instructions and agents --check --require-installed packed assertions. Two-axis review: standards approve (2 nits), spec approve-with-nits (1 nit); all nits addressed (exact packed command, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION == QUEST_VERSION guard, docstring refresh). PR #158 merged to dev (merge commit 75c214d) after all thirteen required checks passed (6 projection platform + source-gates + 6 per-platform qualifications). Candidate built from dev 75c214d (tree fb25b6cca31f5cb3dc0aeae9eb2127cb35b6bfba): seven tarballs, sha256 manifest 7/7 OK, provenance metadata with npm shasum + SRI integrity per tarball (evidence/package-metadata.json), registry 0.2.9 absent on all seven (fresh prefer-online views). Isolated install proof: root launcher, node launcher, and native binary all report 0.2.9; agents --update-instructions writes 'This project uses Quest CLI 0.2.9'; agents --check --require-installed exits 0; instructions --json data.version 0.2.9; launcher missing-platform diagnostic intact. Zero npm publishes, no tag movement, no promotion, no history rewriting. Environment note: this host began SIGKILLing git processes that touch the 65MB rebuilt blobs mid-order (git add/status/commit and the kernel manager's own git checks all affected); the implementation commits were landed via git plumbing (write-tree/commit-tree/update-ref) and the lease return is retained pending environment recovery.

Disposition note: lease 5627ba49404cc898b8e07ed852e14e06 (slot 3) carries this task's implementation + settlement branch quest/qcli-124-instructions-version; return attempted 6+ times and refused by environment-level git SIGKILLs (kernel reports git exited null), not by lease-state gates. Retained per policy with that exact blocker; worktree clean, branch contained in origin/dev after the settlement merge.
<!-- SECTION:NOTES:END -->

## Final Summary

<!-- SECTION:FINAL_SUMMARY:BEGIN -->
Fixed the shipped 0.2.8 managed-instructions version mismatch (fresh registry install wrote 'This project uses Quest CLI 0.2.7') by deriving the template text and drift message from a single QUEST_VERSION constant consumed by the CLI, so generated managed instructions always name the actual release version and cannot drift from hand-synced literals. Bumped the full Quest package family coherently to 0.2.9 and rebuilt all six platform artifacts. Verified with: red-to-green regressions at the source seam (block and drift message name QUEST_VERSION) and the packed seam (installed tarballs write the package version via agents --update-instructions and agents --check --require-installed exits 0), full check suite green 297/297, all thirteen required CI checks green on PR #158 (merged to dev at 75c214d), a seven-tarball 0.2.9 candidate with immutable provenance (sha256 manifest 7/7, npm shasum + SRI integrity, source commit/tree recorded), registry 0.2.9 absence on all seven packages, and a clean isolated install proving root/native/launcher 0.2.9 with managed instructions naming 0.2.9. Zero npm publishes; publication remains user-owned.
